translations.web: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.
translations.bsb: He sprang to his feet and began to walk. Then he went with them into the temple courts, walking and leaping and praising God.
translations.kjv: And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God.
